records.text: Nielsen estimated that 128 million people watched the Super Bowl game and that viewership increased to 135 million during halftime.

appearances.snippet: Nielsen estimates that 128 million people watched the Super Bowl game last night, forgetting the halftime performance. ... verification.notes: Nielsen's finalized national measurement reports a 125.6 million average audience for Super Bowl LX and 128.2 million for halftime; it identifies 137.8 million as a second-quarter peak. Those figures directly contradict the statement's 128 million game average and 135 million halftime audience.
